steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Medics, former South Paci Plaza, exit 12. One injured, a senior L.G.D. inspector. Get here quickly.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Has the bleeding stopped?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You should know me by now. The wound has closed, but I won't be able to lift my shield for a while.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How are our colleages doing?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We were the only ones who fell. I consider that a small win.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're really not bringing me with you? Reunion's commander may well be hiding inside the L.G.D. Headquarters. It's going to be a brutal fight.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm aware. But considering your condition, it's for the best. Wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hearing you say that stings a bit, but it's fine. I know better.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Remember, be careful out there.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No matter how you look at it, Reunion is weaker than we expected. Despite that, they still managed to take Chernobog.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Also, you have a weak point. I can't stress this enough, but never let your thoughts consume you. Ever.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't be so obsessed with something that you neglect the other possibilities. There is nothing out there worth going off to battle for, except for your continued existence.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll treat this as your advice to me. I'll take it to heart.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hurry up and get better. I'll be waiting for your return after this mission is finished.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll protect the medic team. You should get going.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: Reunion has already passed the Causeway Bell.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: Report from AU7: Reunion is also assembling in Ha Wan. I repeat, Reunion is currently assembling. This is AU7's mission briefing.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: Squad AO3 has eliminated the Reunion forces in Front Bay as planned. They are now pushing the remnants back towards the L.G.D. Headquarters.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: All enemies in front of Scorpio Palace have been annihilated. Now retreating towards Charles Avenue to head to the rally point. This is Squad AL1's report, over.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: These are the updates on Reunion's movements and each squad's progress.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: Over.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Continue the operation. Our objective is to drive all Reunion forces into the designated area.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If small groups of stragglers are seen in other districts, you are authorized to eliminate them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Try to draw them out if possible. Focus on avoiding casualties. We'll need to preserve our strength.

steps.name: Radio Operator
steps.text: Yes ma'am.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmm? Another call?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hello, hello? Is this Ah Ch'en? Are you still there?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What did you call me?!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ah Ch'en. You're done for! You're so dead for what happened at Paci Plaza. I heard it myself - you were the one who gave those orders!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Is that all you wanted to say?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Look, why did you reject Rhodes Island's help? Was it because you felt guilty?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't recall you being a psychologist.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll help you make reparations.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Reparations?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hehe, I can't tell you yet.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But, you're so done for because of what you did!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: By the way, do you still remember that one restaurant in Sheung Wan?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh? Which one? Well, whichever one it is, they're all closed now!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wait... are you trying to change the subject?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The one with that absolutely divine steak sandwich.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh? Oh... OHH! I just remembered! The restaurant with a steak burger as big as your palms put side by side!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's the one.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I used to go there quite often while on my patrols... Get down! Who said you could stand up?!
Aaah!!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What was that place called again? Goodie Foodie?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sounds about right.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Aha, now I get it. You're going to treat me to a meal, aren't you? But why don't we go to some place a bit more high-class?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your idea of 'high-class' is very different from mine.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Come on, I can foot the bill.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Miss S, do you really think I'm that kind of person?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Do you want to try calling me that again?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry, I bit my tongue.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You clearly did that on purpose!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Swire, I was just thinking... If we don't do a better job this time, we won't be able to face the locals.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Our businesses depend on Lungmen, and Lungmen also depends on them.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: If you feel that way, you should stop running your mouth. The sooner we take down Reunion, the sooner you can treat me to brunch.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Seems like the fighting is pretty intense on your end as well?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ah, it's fine. I can handle it.
Quick! They're about to get away!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How annoying! Hey, hurry it up! We don't have all day!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ah Ch'en! I want a steak, tomato, and egg burger!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry for accidentally locking you up in the vault that other time.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You call that an accident? ! I know you did that on purpose! Whatever, it felt cathartic splashing water all over you this morning, so I guess we're even.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey, Ah Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Safety first. Don't throw your life away for the sake of what's immediately in front of you. Remember that there are lots of people who are counting on you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph, is that so. Thanks for your advice.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Now that you're in front of the restaurant, that means you're almost at the L.G.D. Headquarters, right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Good luck.
7:40 P.M. \ Overcast
670m east of L.G.D. Headquarters, Upper Factor St., Upper Lungmen

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, Fourth Mobile Squad reporting in.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: All of you assembled here are the cream of the crop. As we speak, many of our colleagues are still out there fighting. But we have our own mission.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The building in front of us used to be the symbol of Lungmen's safety — the embodiment of law and order, the heart of the L.G.D.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But now, it has fallen into Reunion's hands, and has been tainted by conspiracy and warfare.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Some of you might see this as just another job. Some of you might be saddened, while others might be enraged.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No matter how you feel, we are the L.G.D. We aren't rioters, nor are we criminals.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We will take back our headquarters, not necessarily for the sake of pride or justice.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We will do it because we are the L.G.D., and we will take back what belongs to us. That's the only reason we need.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do not make Lungmen worry about us. Do I make myself clear?! Obedience, diligence, and perseverance!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's time. Let us rid the L.G.D. Headquarters of every last Reunion member!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Yes ma'am!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's go.
